calculation.expression: lag1((log(close/close[-20])) / rolling_std(log_returns,40)) if rolling_std(log_returns,10)[-1] < rolling_std(log_returns,60)[-1], else missing
calculation.description: Ranks assets by 20-day log momentum scaled by 40-day daily log-return volatility, activated only when lagged short-term volatility is below lagged 60-day volatility. The one-session lag prevents look-ahead and the compression condition seeks continuation after volatility contraction. Cross-sectional rank usage is recommended.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across chronological thirds at the admitted 20-day horizon: 0.08692, 0.05180, and 0.06483. Short horizons were weaker, indicating medium-horizon continuation rather than immediate timing. Small cross-asset universe implies conservative interpretation of IC uncertainty.
validation.admission: Passes absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840 at the 20-day horizon.
